authority.rule: Only the protected machine registry allocates executable work. Markdown and issue surfaces are discovery aids only.

source_pool.rule: These six organizer IDs are authoritative members of the unresolved source pool. Their order does not define H2-H7 slot correspondence.

discovery.stable_rule: A zero-context external worker is given this registry path plus one dispatch_id. It resolves only the assignment bound to that dispatch_id.

assignment_states.AVAILABLE_FOR_LEASE: Visible to the allocator, but not executable by an external worker.
assignment_states.LEASED: Executable only by the agent_ref and dispatch_id named in the protected lease.
assignment_states.BLOCKED_SOURCE_LOCK: Not executable until the exact protected MATHFORGE source lock named by the assignment exists.
assignment_states.BLOCKED: Terminated at a precise blocker and no longer executable.

lease_policy.allocator: GCL dispatch/controller or Human Steward through protected repository mutation
lease_policy.atomic_unit: one assignment_id to one dispatch_id to one agent_ref
lease_policy.start_rule: An agent starts only when protected main shows state LEASED and the lease dispatch_id equals the dispatch_id supplied in its launch bootstrap.
lease_policy.no_lease_rule: If no matching protected lease exists, return NO_ACTIVE_LEASE and stop without substantive work.
lease_policy.duplicate_rule: A second agent must not execute an assignment already LEASED unless a distinct independently-authorized assignment record exists.
lease_policy.release_rule: Lease release or reassignment requires another protected registry mutation; issue comments or chat text do not alter the lease.

slot_binding_policy.rule: Source acquisition is assigned by exact organizer hill ID, never by H2-H7 list position. Slot binding is a separate protected act after source lock.

mathematics_release_policy.rule: No H2-H7 hill-specific mathematical assignment may enter AVAILABLE_FOR_LEASE or LEASED before a protected MATHFORGE source lock and explicit protected slot binding exist for that hill.

return_policy.rule: The lease/dispatch record names the exact GitHub return surface and exact result grammar. Assignment discovery alone never authorizes a return location.
return_policy.receipt_effect: Receipt is evidence received, not mathematical admission or certification.

assignments.successor_gate: After a protected MATHFORGE source lock exists, GCL may explicitly bind this hill to one free OM26-H2..H7 slot and only then instantiate hill-specific mathematical assignments.
